bugs.name: RECEIPT_AT_THRESHOLD
bugs.trigger: Submit a claim of exactly the receipt threshold with no receipt.
bugs.expected: 422 RECEIPT_REQUIRED: receipts are needed for claims of the threshold or more.

bugs.name: AGE_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.trigger: Submit a claim dated max_claim_age_days + 1 days ago.

bugs.name: FUTURE_DATE_ALLOWED
bugs.trigger: Submit a claim dated tomorrow.

bugs.name: MEAL_CAP_WRONG_GRADE
bugs.trigger: A G3 employee submits a meal above the G1 cap but within the G3 cap.
bugs.expected: Submitted (200): the cap follows the employee's grade.
bugs.actual: 422 MEAL_OVER_CAP: the G1 cap is used for everyone.

bugs.name: FX_TRUNCATES
bugs.trigger: Create a foreign-currency claim whose rupee value has a third decimal of 5 or more (e.g. USD 12.50).
bugs.expected: amount_inr rounded half-up to the paisa (1040.63).

bugs.name: SELF_APPROVAL
bugs.trigger: A manager submits a claim and approves it themselves.
bugs.expected: 403: nobody can approve their own claim.

bugs.name: PARTIAL_OVER_CLAIMED
bugs.trigger: Approve with approved_amount above the claimed amount.

bugs.name: PAY_SKIPS_FINANCE
bugs.trigger: Finance pays a manager-approved claim above manager_approval_limit without finance approval.

bugs.name: DUPLICATE_ALLOWED
bugs.trigger: Submit two claims with the same merchant, date and amount.

bugs.name: OTHER_CLAIM_VISIBLE
bugs.trigger: Employee B opens employee A's claim by id.

bugs.name: TOTAL_IGNORES_FILTERS
bugs.trigger: List claims with a category filter.
bugs.actual: total counts all of the user's claims.

bugs.name: SORT_DIRECTION_IGNORED
bugs.trigger: List with sort=-amount.

bugs.name: ERROR_WRONG_FIELD
bugs.trigger: Create a claim with amount 0.
bugs.expected: 422 with loc ending in the amount field.

bugs.name: SEARCH_CASE_SENSITIVE
bugs.trigger: Search claims with q in a different case from the merchant ("uber").
bugs.actual: No results unless the case matches.

bugs.name: PROJECT_SEARCH_CASE_SENSITIVE
bugs.trigger: GET /projects?q=atlas.

bugs.name: STATUS_FILTER_FIRST_ONLY
bugs.trigger: List with status=SUBMITTED&status=DRAFT.

bugs.name: DATE_TO_EXCLUSIVE
bugs.trigger: Filter with date_to equal to a claim's expense date.

bugs.name: PAGE_OVERLAP
bugs.trigger: Read page 2 after page 1 with the same sort.
bugs.expected: No claim appears on both pages.
bugs.actual: Page 2 starts with the last claim of page 1.

bugs.name: ERROR_UNDER_WRONG_FIELD
bugs.trigger: Leave Merchant empty and continue.

bugs.name: SUMMARY_UNROUNDED
bugs.trigger: Enter a foreign amount whose rupee value has more than two decimals.
bugs.expected: The summary shows rupees to two decimals.
bugs.actual: The summary shows the raw product (e.g. ₹832.91625).

bugs.name: DOUBLE_SUBMIT
bugs.trigger: Click the final submit button twice quickly.
bugs.expected: The button is disabled while saving; one claim is created.
bugs.actual: The button stays enabled; a second request is sent.

bugs.name: FILTER_KEEPS_PAGE
bugs.trigger: Go to page 2, then change a filter.
bugs.expected: The list goes back to page 1.
bugs.actual: The list stays on page 2, often empty.

bugs.name: DATE_SHIFTS_DAY
bugs.trigger: Pick or type an expense date with the browser in a timezone ahead of UTC (Playwright: timezoneId 'Asia/Kolkata').

bugs.name: SENT_BACK_AS_REJECTED
bugs.trigger: Look at a sent-back claim in a list.

bugs.name: GENERIC_ERROR_TOAST
bugs.trigger: As a manager, approve more than the claimed amount in the approve dialog.
bugs.expected: The toast shows the API's reason.
bugs.actual: The toast says Something went wrong.
